Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Proficiency in the Medicine skill
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 2
Order: Craft

Emergency healing and continual care for injured or sick occupants of the Bastion.

Craft Options. When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Craft: Antitoxin. The hirelings craft two vials of Antitoxin in 7 days, at no cost. Spending 50 GP enhances one vial (100 GP for both): an enhanced Antitoxin also ends the Poisoned condition on the creature that drinks it, and loses this enhancement after 28 days.

Craft: Enhanced Potion of Healing. Over 14 days, the hirelings strengthen up to two Potions of Healing you provide, turning each into a Potion of Healing (Greater). From level 13, you can instead provide up to two Potions of Healing (Greater), each becoming a Potion of Healing (Superior).

Triage. When your Bastion is attacked and you roll dice to see how many defenders are lost, you can reroll a number of those dice equal to the hirelings of this facility; you must use the new rolls.

Enlarging the Facility. For 2,000 GP, your Infirmary becomes Vast: it gains two hirelings, and it can enhance up to four Antitoxins or Potions of Healing at a time.

Source: Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.
